headline: OpenAI and Anthropic face antitrust lawsuit over AI development coordination
body: Major AI labs including OpenAI and Anthropic are facing an antitrust suit alleging they agreed to deliberately slow AI development, according to reports verified across multiple sources with a velocity score of 95. The lawsuit claims this alleged coordination has been in motion for months, raising questions about competitive dynamics in the AI market. For healthcare AI stakeholders, antitrust action against foundation model developers creates uncertainty around access, pricing, and which vendors will dominate clinical AI applications. Healthcare systems currently evaluating AI partnerships should monitor litigation outcomes, as consolidation or restricted competition could limit their vendor choices for EHR integration, diagnostic tools, and clinical decision support. Consulting firms advising health systems on AI strategy should incorporate regulatory risk into vendor evaluation frameworks and contract negotiations.
